rule: 用户规则（2026-09-23 修正）：机械臂操作范围内的最大圆 → 面积先按 area_safety 同心缩圆 → 内接正方形 = 评分区；未缩减的内接正方形 = 仿真/物理区（越界不扣分，仍受逐刀 IK/碰撞检查约束）
variant: loose: every point must be reachable face-on (pitch 0) at the wall and 2.5 cm off it; tilted strokes are checked stroke by stroke by the executor instead
why_loose: v0.3 lets RL choose the pitch; requiring 30 deg everywhere would pre-empt that choice and costs ~8 cm of height (see experiments/v0.3/r0/records/2026-09-22_wall_cycle_v03/raw/reach)
analysis: tools/simulation/v2_trowel_reach.py --pitches 0 --distances 0.28 0.30 0.33 0.35 0.38 --step 0.01 (v0.7: 沿用此前扫描已产生的 circle_radius_m=0.165，未重新扫描；正方形推导公式按 area_safety 作用在圆面积重新计算。建议在实验室电脑上补跑一次该命令，生成新的 reach.json 存档，数值应与此一致，仅作可复现记录，不是重新验证可达性)
joint_limits: V2 firmware candidates, J6 clipped to +/-180 deg; NOT calibrated (M3)
note: z is height above the base underside (world z). score_square 与 sim_square 同心（centre_u_m/centre_z_m 相同）。Re-run after M3 measures the joint limits.
